name: frankirocks
description: Franki, an avatar-first, voice-first life assistant. Kiroween 2026 entry.
author: Matt Avila

scripts.typecheck: turbo run typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/judge-spike && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/extract-check && tsc --noEmit -p tests
scripts.test:fast: vitest run packages/core/src/schema packages/core/src/lineage packages/core/src/slices packages/server/src/store packages/server/src/worker/extract.lineage
scripts.test:emulator: npx -y firebase-tools@15.34.2 emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-franki "vitest run --config vitest.emulator.config.ts"
